title: AGO - Problem closed resolve PagerDuty (SNOW via classic notification)
description: When Dynatrace Problem closes, resolve PagerDuty with dedup_key. ServiceNow ITOM update comes from classic Problem notification silvastg.

eventTrigger.filterQuery: event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND (event.status == "CLOSED" OR event.status_transition == "RESOLVED" OR event.status_transition == "CLOSED")

prepare-close-ids.name: prepare-close-ids
prepare-close-ids.description: Build problemId and dedupKey from closed Problem event.

resolve-pagerduty-incident.name: resolve-pagerduty-incident
resolve-pagerduty-incident.description: Resolve PagerDuty with same dedup_key as open workflow.
